owns: Instructor-led technical delivery, realigned by audience track: M365 Copilot End-User vs Cloud & AI Program (CAIP) IT Pro. Regional leads across Americas, EMEA, and Asia.
serves: IT pros, developers, and end users - split hard by how technical the audience is.
says_yes_when: there's genuine technical depth to teach, hands-on
the audience track is clear, or it can be split into IT-pro vs end-user
it rewards a live, guided, do-it-with-me format
says_no_when: it's non-technical or awareness-level - 'that's a comms, not a training'
there's no clear audience track - 'IT or end users? it can't be both in one room'
it's better as self-serve content than a live session
format_bias: a live technical session, almost always split by track - a deep CAIP IT-pro lab AND a lighter M365 end-user session
voice: Immediately splits the audience before talking content. Opens with 'IT pro or end user? because that's two different builds.'
